title: Global Partners and Coca-Cola® Bring Back Award-Winning “Cheers for a Cause” for a Fourth Season of Holiday Giving
summary: Bee’s Knees Benefits™ members can choose a charity, enjoy a free Coca-Cola beverage, and help raise up to $50,000 for Boys & Girls Clubs of America,
body_markdown:
***Bee’s Knees Benefits™ members can choose a charity, enjoy a free Coca-Cola beverage, and help raise up to $50,000 for Boys & Girls Clubs of America, Feeding America, and Children’s Miracle Network***


**Newton, Mass. (November 6, 2026) –** *Cheers for a Cause* is back for its fourth holiday season, turning a free drink into a donation for a cause that matters. The award-winning program, created by Global Partners, a leading independent liquid energy supplier and retail operator, in partnership with Coca-Cola, invites members of the Bee’s Knees Benefits loyalty program to choose one of three national charities to receive a donation. In return, each member who makes a selection earns a free Coca-Cola beverage. For every selection, Global donates $2.50 to the chosen charity, with a goal of contributing $50,000 this season. The campaign runs at participating locations across Global’s portfolio of retail brands: Alltown Fresh, Honey Farms Market, Alltown, XtraMart, Jiffy Mart, Millers and more.


“The holidays are about giving, and Cheers for a Cause makes it easy for everyone to take part,” said Joanna Linder, Vice President of Marketing at Global Partners. “Our members enjoy a drink they already love, and every choice they make sends real support to families and kids in our communities. It’s joy and generosity in every sip.”


After selecting a charity through the Bee’s Knees Benefits app or website, members instantly receive a free 20 oz Coke®, Sprite®, or smartwater® in their loyalty account. Participation resets weekly, and members can return to choose a charity and earn another free beverage up to three times between November 5, 2026, and January 6, 2027. That’s a potential $7.50 donated per member, along with three chances to refresh this season. All free drink rewards are valid through January 31, 2027.


This year, members can choose to support one of the following charities:[Boys & Girls Clubs of America](https://www.bgca.org/) , which empowers young people with safe spaces, caring mentors, and opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive;[Feeding America](https://www.feedingamerica.org/) , which provides food to people and food banks in need while working toward a future where no one goes hungry; and[Children’s Miracle Network](https://childrensmiraclenetworkhospitals.org/) , which provides children’s hospitals with critical care, treatments, and resources for the kids who need them most.


The program’s impact has been recognized across the industry. In 2026, Cheers for a Cause received the Convenience Store News Promotional Excellence Award and a Loyaltees Award from Paytronix for Best Use of a Loyalty System to Drive a Charitable Initiative.


Since its inception, the program has contributed $145,000 to charities. With Coca-Cola covering the cost of every beverage and Global Partners funding the donations, participants can trust that their involvement results in real, tangible support for the causes they care about.


Global Partners’ retail locations are dedicated to making a positive impact on the communities they serve through active partnerships with charitable organizations. From collecting spare change for nonprofits supporting children to hosting car washes for local schools and running food and fuel donation programs, Global’s retail locations contribute more than $500,000 annually to help support a wide range of causes, ensuring communities keep growing, moving, and thriving throughout the year.


Not a Bee’s Knees Benefits member? Joining is free and easy. Visit[beeskneesbenefits.com](https://beeskneesbenefits.com/) to sign up today and raise a glass to giving back.


**About Global Partners LP:**


*Building on a legacy that began more than 90 years ago, Global Partners has evolved into a Fortune 500 company and industry-leading integrated owner, supplier, and operator of liquid energy terminals, fueling locations, and guest-focused retail experiences. Global operates or maintains dedicated storage at 54 liquid energy terminals—with connectivity to strategic rail, pipeline, and marine assets—spanning from Maine to Florida and into the U.S. Gulf States. Through this extensive network, the company distributes gasoline, distillates, residual oil, and renewable fuels to wholesalers, retailers, and commercial customers. In addition, Global has a large portfolio of owned, leased and/or supplied retail locations across the Northeast states, the Mid-Atlantic, and Texas, providing the fuels people need to keep them on the go at their unique guest-focused convenience destinations. Recognized as one of Fortune’s Most Admired Companies, Global Partners is embracing progress and diversifying to meet the needs of the energy transition.*
